insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Azir against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Azir against them in 20/29 games (69%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Varus? They go Corki
insights.text: Varus is a G1 favorite (7/18 G1s, played by Patrik). In the 8 later games where it was burned or banned, Patrik went to Corki (3/8) and Kai'Sa (2/8).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 13/29 games (45%): 9 picks (2-7) and 4 bans.
